Dear Sir/Madam,
Subject: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing
Obligations and Disclosures Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ‐ Share Purchase
Agreement.
In furtherance to our intimation made on September 08, 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 30 of the
Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements)
Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”), as amended from time to time, we wish to inform you
that the Company has entered into Share Purchase Agreement on 19th October, 2026 with M/s.
Veritas Industries Private Limited (“VIPL”) and M/s. Wire Brigade Industries Private Limited (“WBIPL”)
for the purpose of acquiring 10,000 Equity Shares of WBIPL (i.e.,100% of Equity Shareholding) (Sale
Shares) from VIPL for cash and for consideration other than cash (share swap).
Further, pursuant to the above acquisition of shares, WBIPL will become Wholly Owned Subsidiary
Company of the Company.
The details as required under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations read with applicable SEBI
Master Circular is enclosed herewith as Annexure – I.
The above information will also be made available on the website of the Company at:
www.systematicindustries.com.

 You are requested to take the above information on your record.
Thanking you.
Yours Sincerely,
For Systematic Industries Limited
(Formerly known as Systematic Industries Private Limited)

LALWAN
I DIMPLE
